title: cortextOS fully automated my cold email outreach
description: My cold email outreach runs without me now. My agents scrape hundreds of leads a day out of Apollo, go to each website and enrich them, drop them into my CRM, then load them into Smartlead and queue the sends, every single day on a schedule. I get full daily stats on the whole campaign, conversion rates per email, and deliverability health, all on a page cortextOS literally built itself for my outreach. This is the kind of back-office work the system just runs on its own while I work on everything else. Link in bio.
